caption: The drawing features a single jug with a round base, gently sloping shoulders, and a short, narrow neck with a small lip at the top. The jug has one attached handle emerging from the upper part of the body and connecting to the neck near the rim. Its surface is depicted with a brown, textured, and mottled pattern, displaying vertical streaks and irregular spots, giving an impression of dripped glaze. The jug sits against a plain, off-white or light beige background, centered within a rectangular frame. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name "Annie B. Johnston" is written in small, neat handwriting.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
